mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressures that may lead to tighter monetary policy, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in Real Final Sales of Domestic Product (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which negatively impacts corporate earnings and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines > 5% YoY and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market weakness, leading to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises unexpectedly and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) indicates supply chain disruptions or reduced manufacturing output, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines > 2% MoM and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 7%, it signals a monetary policy response to economic weakness, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and UNRATE > 7% and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which positively impacts related industries and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 10% YoY and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% and Industrial Production (INDPRO) is declining, it signals a supply-side recession, negatively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 1% and INDPRO declines > 1% YoY
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth < 1% and INDPRO declines > 1% YoY and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC < 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.
